title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Understanding Sustainable Operation Management
description: Master sustainable operations and propel your business towards a thriving future.
longDescription: Dive into the transformative world of sustainable operations management. Embark on a journey towards environmental and economic success, equipping yourself with vision, leadership skills, and practical best practices. Learn to integrate sustainability into all aspects of your operations, from strategic planning to material management and beyond.
courseDetails: Understand the importance of strategic planning in operation management. Know the elements of operations management strategic planning. Know what is the role of leadership in business processes. Understand how sustainable leadership’s vision and performance management integrate business processes effectively. Know how leaders help develop management-level commitment to sustainability. Understand the role of sustainable leaders in minimising the risks and maximizing the opportunities. Also understand the strategies for quality assurance. Development of sustainable products and services. 3P’s (profit, people, planet) in product and process design. Internal and external process improvements related to sustainability. Production process management. Procurement and green supply chain management (lean vs green). Operations, inventory models, off-shoring. Materials management planning, distribution, integration. Understand the concept of material management planning, distribution and integration. Know that industrial ecology takes industrial systems as interwoven parts of greater ecological and social systems and seeks to improve sustainability, reduce environmental effect, and maximize resource utilization in industrial operations. Understand the concept of supply chain management and how businesses may build long-term resilience, cut expenses, and improve their brand image by incorporating sustainable practices into their supply chains. Know the importance of sustainable outsourcing and sustainable disposal and recycling of materials. Delve into the foundations of sustainable operations management, covering vision, leadership, and strategic planning. Explore systematic frameworks, key principles, and issues in operations management. Understand sustainable practices in product and process design, internal and external process improvements, production process management, green supply chain practices, and more. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Introduction to Sustainable Operations: Strategic Planning in Sustainable Operations Management: Principles and Best Practices of Sustainability and Operations Management: Integrated Business Operations Material and HR Marketing Management:
